name: browser-errors-empty
goal: Represent unavailable and empty browser diagnostic records without implying a passing test.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: BrowserErrors renders no DOM for an absent or empty diagnostics collection; isolated component screenshots are blank. Distinguish unavailable diagnostics from an explicitly empty collection without calling either a successful test.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The component catalog has diagnostic-attempt examples but no absent or empty collection variants. Add both to the existing catalog scenario and assert neutral messages; retain quiet behavior in the Reports and Desktop test consumers.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Red record 79c7c282f7ee: both new catalog examples rendered no visible component and failed the visibility assertion.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Show neutral unavailable or empty messages, while the Reports and Desktop consumers skip empty collections.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Green record 4830dd733669: the same browser command, tests and fixtures passed at the fix commit.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
